definitions.short: an embrasure or opening with bevelled jam
definitions.full: H8261. shaquph [ שְׁקוּף שָׁקוּף, ] noun masculine 1Kin 6:4 frame, casing of windows ; — plural שְׁקֻפִים חַלּוֺנֵי 6:4 windows of narrowing frames , so read also, inserting ׳שׁ , Ezek 41:16 (Co Toy; > Krae Berthol read ׳שׁ for שְׂחִיף v b ); ׳שׁ alone 1Kin 7:4 .
